meta.title: Browser tuner
meta.description: A calm, private browser tuner for guitar and bass.

tuner.heading: Tuner
tuner.intro: A focused tuning space for every practice session.

chromatic.supportedRange: Chromatic Reference Tones support C1 through B7.

status.listenReady: Start tuning when your instrument is ready.
status.ready: Choose a String and hear its Target Pitch.
status.readyChromatic: Choose a note and octave, then hear the Target Pitch.

status.error: The Reference Tone could not start. Check browser audio and try again.

microphone.permission-denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in browser settings, then try again, or use Reference Tone.
microphone.microphone-unavailable: No microphone is available. Connect or enable one, then try again, or use Reference Tone.

interruption.muted: The microphone was muted. Unmute it, then resume tuning.
interruption.ended: The microphone disconnected. Check it, then resume tuning.
interruption.page-hidden: Tuning paused while this page was hidden. Resume when you are ready.
interruption.audio-suspended: The browser paused audio. Resume tuning to continue.
interruption.audio-failed: Browser audio stopped. Check your audio device, then resume tuning.
interruption.inactive: The microphone stopped after five minutes without a usable signal. Resume to try again.

tuner.privacy: Audio is processed on this device. It is not recorded or uploaded.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How Tune Every String keeps audio and pitch measurements on your device.
privacy.audio: Tune Every String processes microphone audio on your device to estimate pitch. It does not record audio or upload audio or pitch measurements. Microphone access starts only when you start Listen and stops when you stop tuning or leave the Tuner Screen.
privacy.data: The application does not use analytics or create accounts. It stores tuning preferences and the precise-pitch setting in your browser’s local storage. You can remove them by clearing this site’s data in your browser.
privacy.hosting: Fonts, icons and other visual assets are served with the application. The application makes no runtime requests to third-party services. Your hosting provider receives normal page and asset requests, which may include your IP address and browser information.
